we propose an evaluation framework for continual learning that provides the following: (1) a visual representation of the state-of-the-art, (2) a means for researchers to specify their work in a compact and transparent manner, and (3) a way to compare different approaches in the context of the literature.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the community should not strive to formulate a single evaluation protocol but rather to promote transparency and comparability.
